title: feat: add activity related fields into the form data
body:
<!-- Please provide the issue number here if any -->

## Changelog Entry

### Added

- Added support for including activity ID and key into form data indicated by corresponding data attributes, in PR [#5418](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5418), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny)

## Description

This PR enhances form handling within activities by including activity-related information (ID and/or key) in the form data when submitted upon developer ask.

## Design

Data is injected through FormData event only when asked for, preventing direct DOM access

## Specific Changes

- Added `data-webchat-include-activity-id` and `data-webchat-include-activity-key` data attributes handling for extending FormData
- Implemented FormData event handler in `ActivityRow` component
- Updated ref handling to support form data injection
- Added a test  for form data injection scenarios:
  - Verification of activity ID/key presence in form submissions
  - Testing hijacked form behavior
